retrievals.query: Native web research for Open investment evidence: team, product, market, traction, competitors, freshness

claims.claim: YC identifies Mohammad Gharbat as the founder and describes a team including programming-language builders, a cybersecurity competition winner, and a dentist.
Open says it trains AI agents from more than 27 sources and deploys them across web, email, phone, SMS, WhatsApp, and Slack for complex support workflows.
Omnichannel support is a recurring operational need, but Open explicitly targets enterprises and high-growth businesses with more than 5,000 support tickets per month.
Open says customers have processed and resolved thousands of complex issues and names production customers including Print.com, Mollie.com, Viva.com, and More.com.
YC lists Open as active in the Winter 2024 batch with 21 employees and reports a January 2025 funding announcement.
